name: Jeff-Gemma4-E2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-E2B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-E2B-it: 7 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim 256) and 28 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of google/gemma-4-E2B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, the card's '2B effective (4.6B stored)' layout (safetensors total 4,628,569,344) . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-28. Active parameters set to the 2.0B the card names, not the 5.12B inherited from the Gemma 4 E2B IT record: the gemma-4-E2B base record stores 5.12B, this repo stores 4.63B, and the card describes the same 2B-effective split. CAVEAT: 'Base model's panel accuracy (untrained)' is the base doing zero-shot classification with no head and no tuning, so the 62.5 -> 81.6 jump is largely what the fine-tune teaches rather than a capability the base had. The 5-benchmark 'Overall' is a card-defined equal-weight aggregate. The card also carries a Superseded banner: this is an earlier Jeff release, current line is mstrasser/jeff-base. Decision model, so excluded from the worth-running ranking.
